sara: Quick ask — saw a brief 4xx spike ~10:12 UTC on prod that affected /v1/generate routes. Need where to grab per-route 4xx/5xx breakdown, example trace IDs, and a quick suggestion for alert debounce. Anyone with the right dash/trace links? :wave:

michael: Try Prod -> HTTP Error Rate dashboard (Grafana). Panels: Route 4xx/5xx by upstream. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/prod-http-errors
Also use Loki query for sample traces:

```logql
{job="ingress"} | json | route="/v1/generate" | status>=400 | sort_desc(@timestamp) | limit 50
```

priyanka: For traces, use Jaeger -> service=ingress, operation=POST /v1/generate, time ~10:00-10:20 UTC. Sample span ids: a1b2c3d4. I can grab one if you want.

sara: thanks — can you paste one sample trace id when you find it? Also any quick alert tuning recommendation? Right now we trigger on 5m spike >2% which catches noisy bursts.

oscar: Re: alerting — consider switching to `sum(rate(errors[5m]))/sum(rate(requests[5m]))` per-route with a 3m evaluation window and 2 consecutive evals, or add a 'burst' mute rule for client IPs. Example alert rule (pseudo):

```
alert: HighRoute4xx
expr: (sum by(route)(rate(http_requests_total{job="ingress",status=~"4.."}[3m]))
      / sum by(route)(rate(http_requests_total{job="ingress"}[3m]))) > 0.02
for: 6m
```

That reduces flapping and requires sustained errors.

michael: +1. Also consider grouping by client_ip to suppress a noisy crawler. We have an alert mute template under https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alert-mutes

devops-bot: Automated note: linked dashboard panels: prod-http-errors, route-error-heatmap. Runbook: obs/error-rate-playbook

priyanka: Found a trace: trace_id=a1b2c3d4ef56, jump to Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/a1b2c3d4ef56. Root cause looks like backend timeouts to model-host-7; logs show repeated 504s from kube-proxy.

sara: perfect — will attach trace to the ticket and propose updating alert rule to 3m eval/6m for firing. I'll also open a short run to patch the mute rule for that client IP if it recurs. Thanks all :pray:

oscar: pinging infra to check model-host-7 load: @infra-team

sara: follow-up: PR to update alert rule here: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/1234 — reviewers welcome.
